scope: publication-backed measured-label computational benchmarks, not validation of complete biological workflows

resampling.CI: 95% percentile, target-cluster where available; guide-level otherwise

comparison_policy: Only compare models on identical rows/labels/features when supported; no cross-paper headline subtraction unless protocol is matched
paired_Cas9: RS3 minus CRISPRon Spearman difference; paired bootstrap within each assay; exploratory intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted superiority tests
primary_Cas9_panel: Deduplicated common context join, separately from original duplicate-weighted source replay
diagnostics: Author numeric-score replay ONLY; paired common row subset plus per-model availability. No sequence columns loaded; no inference, guide design or pathogen performance optimization
blocked_stages: Remain blocked, not converted into pass by choosing another endpoint
